How to unlock

Pro item — the code was never copied here. With an active ThreeUI Pro membership:

npx @designcodeio/threeui-cli login
npx @designcodeio/threeui-cli add branches --dir ./src

Then in threeui-library run npm run update, and rebuild this site with npm run rebuild. Tell me the number (#484) and I will fetch it for you.
